nodes.name: SkillTrendRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository for SkillTrend entities, providing lookup by a set of skill IDs ordered by week.

nodes.name: SkillTrendRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository interface for SkillTrend entities.

nodes.name: JobScrapingScheduler.java
nodes.summary: Scheduled job that triggers TopCV/ITviec scraping via the AI service, then persists the returned companies, recruitments, and recruitment posts transactionally.

nodes.name: JobScrapingScheduler
nodes.summary: Spring scheduled component orchestrating job scraping and persisting results across multiple repositories.

nodes.name: fetchJobsFromPython
nodes.summary: Scheduled entry point that triggers scraping from all configured sources and logs failures.

nodes.name: fetchJobs
nodes.summary: Triggers the AI service scrape for a given source and persists the returned scraper response within a transaction.

nodes.name: persistScrapedData
nodes.summary: Upserts scraped companies, recruitments, and recruitment posts into their respective repositories, parsing dates and deduplicating existing posts.

nodes.name: RemoveOverdueJobScheduler.java
nodes.summary: Scheduled job that periodically deletes recruitment posts whose expiry date has passed.

nodes.name: RemoveOverdueJobScheduler
nodes.summary: Spring scheduled component that cleans up expired recruitment posts.

nodes.name: removeOverdueRecruitmentPosts
nodes.summary: Scheduled task that deletes all recruitment posts whose expiry date is before today.

nodes.name: SkillExtractionScheduler.java
nodes.summary: Scheduled job that triggers skill extraction and rebuilding of skill-trend aggregates from current recruitment postings.

nodes.name: SkillExtractionScheduler
nodes.summary: Spring scheduled component that triggers periodic skill extraction and trend rebuilding.

nodes.name: runSkillExtractionJob
nodes.summary: Scheduled task that invokes SkillExtractionService to extract skills and rebuild skill-trend aggregates, logging success or failure.

nodes.name: MarketTrendService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining market-trend analytics operations (top hiring companies, skill trends, salary distribution).

nodes.name: MarketTrendService
nodes.summary: Service interface contract for market-trend analytics operations.

nodes.name: ScraperService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining read operations over scraped recruitment posts, company info, and recruitment info.

nodes.name: ScraperService
nodes.summary: Service interface contract for recruitment/company/recruitment-post read operations.

nodes.name: SkillExtractionService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface exposing a single operation to extract skills from recruitment postings and rebuild skill-trend aggregates.

nodes.name: SkillExtractionService
nodes.summary: Service interface contract for the skill extraction and trend-rebuilding operation.

nodes.name: MarketTrendServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements market-trend analytics: top hiring companies via a repository aggregate query, skill trend grouping, and regex-based salary bucket distribution.

nodes.name: MarketTrendServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation of MarketTrendService providing top-hiring-company, skill-trend, and salary-distribution analytics.

nodes.name: getTopHiringCompanies
nodes.summary: Queries the top hiring companies with recruitment counts and maps each row to a CompanyTrendResponse via the mapper.

nodes.name: getSkillTrends
nodes.summary: Groups all skill trends by skill, resolves skill names, maps each group to a SkillTrendResponse, and returns the top 10 by total demand.

nodes.name: getSalaryDistribution
nodes.summary: Parses free-text salary strings with regex to bucket recruitment postings into salary ranges (under 10M up to over 50M VND).

nodes.name: ScraperServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements recruitment browsing: joins recruitment posts with company and recruitment entities, flattens tag data, and maps to response DTOs with not-found handling.

nodes.name: ScraperServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation of ScraperService providing recruitment post listing and detail lookups with DTO mapping and not-found handling.

nodes.name: getRecruitmentPosts
nodes.summary: Loads all recruitment posts and joins each with its company and recruitment records, flattening tag data into RecruitmentPostResponse DTOs.

nodes.name: getCompanyInfos
nodes.summary: Looks up a company by external ID and maps it to a CompanyResponse, throwing ResourceNotFoundException when absent.

nodes.name: getRecruitmentInfos
nodes.summary: Looks up a recruitment by external ID and maps it to a RecruitmentResponse, throwing ResourceNotFoundException when absent.

nodes.name: SkillExtractionServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements skill extraction by building descriptions from all recruitments, calling the AI service to extract skills per posting, then rebuilding weekly SkillTrend aggregates.

nodes.name: SkillExtractionServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation of SkillExtractionService that calls the AI service to extract skills and rebuilds SkillTrend aggregates.

nodes.name: extractAndRebuildSkillTrends
nodes.summary: Builds text descriptions from all recruitment postings, calls the AI service to extract skills per posting, then replaces all SkillTrend rows with freshly aggregated weekly demand counts.
